ADT_A17.note: The standard lists the two patients flat (PID [PD1] PV1 [PV2] [{DB1}] [{OBX}] twice); modelled as one PATIENT group occurring exactly twice (patients[0], patients[1]), the same segments in the same order. hl7.eu ch3 3.2.17, Caristix and HAPI v23 agree on the flat form.

ADT_A24.note: The standard lists the two patients flat (PID [PD1] [PV1] [{DB1}] twice); modelled as one PATIENT group occurring exactly twice. hl7.eu ch3 3.2.24, Caristix and HAPI v23 agree on the flat form.

ORU_R01.note: The OBSERVATION group is written { [OBX] [{NTE}] } (a required group whose OBX is optional) by hl7.eu ch7 7.2.1, Caristix and HAPI v23; modelled as [{ OBX [{NTE}] }], which parses the same messages and keeps an observation from being built without its OBX.

ORU_W01.note: Wraps ORU^R01 (hl7.eu ch7 7.19.1: the ORU message under the W01 trigger event); the OBSERVATION modelling note of ORU_R01 applies. No hl7.eu table of its own; HAPI v23 has no ORU_W01 class.

MFK_M01.note: hl7.eu ch8 8.3 defines MFK for every event as MSH MSA [ERR] MFI {[MFA]}. Caristix puts ERR after MFI and lists MFI and an MF group twice for M01; HAPI v23 copies that. The general definition is kept.

MFK_M02.note: hl7.eu ch8 8.3: MSH MSA [ERR] MFI {[MFA]}; Caristix agrees, HAPI v23 lacks ERR.

MFN_M09.note: hl7.eu ch8 8.7 (MFI-1 = OMB, categorical observations): { MFE OM1 [ OM3 [{OM4}] ] }; Caristix agrees, HAPI v23 leaves out OM1.

MFN_M10.note: hl7.eu ch8 8.7 (MFI-1 = OMC, batteries): { MFE OM1 [ OM5 [{OM4}] ] }; Caristix agrees, HAPI v23 leaves out OM1.
